text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized. 3. Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5.
